VISHAL PRAKASH

DATA SCIENTIST

Objective

9096153599

vpraksh634@gmail.com

Pimple Saudagar, Pune:411017

Being a Data Scientist Enthusiast looking for the challenging opportunity in Data scientist, I intend to be a part of an organization where I can constantly learn and apply my knowledge, integrate myself into the organizational culture and diligently work to add value to it.

SUMMARY

Having 7.1+ years of experience in data science and analytics, I have honed my skills in developing, implementing, and optimizing OpenAI models for various applications, including chatbots and customer support systems.

Designed and developed backend services using Python to support OpenAI-powered solutions.

Worked with custom datasets, utilizing techniques such as chunking and embeddings to train and fine- tune Lang Chain RAG pipeline models.

Integrated AWS/EC2 Deployment Services to extend functionality and enhance AI solutions.

Regularly reviewed and fine-tuned OpenAI models to ensure maximum accuracy and relevance for custom datasets.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure the smooth deployment and integration of AI

Stayed updated with the latest advancements in OpenAI and Azure to drive innovation and GEN AI solutions.

Experienced in developing algorithms for machine learning and deep learning in Python. Proficient in image processing, NLP, and computer vision.

Demonstrated expertise in data manipulation and data wrangling using Python, along with writing well- designed, testable, and efficient code following best software development practices.

Developed data solutions using multiple sources, including Python, R, and various ML

Utilized data visualization tools such as Tableau, and implemented techniques in deep learning, NLP, computer vision, OpenCV, CNN, Mask R-CNN, PyTorch, RNN, and other platform APIs.

Collaborated with team members to optimize customer engagement and experience.

Created data visualizations for complex datasets and analytics results using modern visualization tools and predictive analytics.

Experienced in the Led rapid model creation in Python using Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, and Plotly for effective data visualization.

Analyzed system or data processes, data structures, and analytics methods, applying key data science techniques (machine learning, data mining, analysis) to build high-quality predictive systems.

Identified hidden patterns or systematic risks through qualitative and quantitative data analysis.

Developed solutions that enable highly effective presentations and engaging visualizations for decision- making.

Collaborated with data scientists to develop a Python codebase for predictive and prescriptive modeling, along with other data science capabilities.

Created a multivariate regression-based attribution model and segmentation module using K-means clustering.

Developed an NLP model for sentiment analysis for predictive analytics on AWS (EC2).

Experienced in the development of modules for AI and neural networks using Python and other technologies.

Experience	

3.7+ years of experience as a Data Scientist with python developer at CAPGEMINI ENGINEERING PVT. LTD from 1 APRIL 2022 to the present.

1 years of experience as a Data Scientist with python developer at STARLINK TECHNOLOGY PVT.LTD (www.starlinkinfo.in) from 4 Jan 2021 to 14 DEC 2021

2.5+ years of experience as a Data Scientist with python developer at HCL CDC PUNE from 10 July 2018 to 31 Dec 2020.



TECHNICAL SKILLS

Data scientist Technologies: Open AI, Chat GPT, Lang Chain, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Embeddings, Fine-Tuning, Chunking, Generative AI Few-Shot and Zero-Shot Learning Vector Database, Llama, machine learning, deep learning, Image processing, NLP, neural network, Artificial Intelligence, computer vision, statistical tool.

Languages: Python, R

Big data- pyspark, Scala.
